input.body:
label: bug
file: src/util/dates.ts

The issue is caused by the startOfWeek function in src/util/dates.ts, which currently does not honor the user's local time zone. It calculates the start of the week (Monday) based on UTC, ignoring the tz parameter. This makes the weekly summary email timing offset for users in time zones ahead of UTC, like Sydney, resulting in their Monday summary arriving on Tuesday.

Fixing startOfWeek to correctly calculate the week start instant in the user's time zone should resolve this issue.

text:
The problem is that the function startOfWeek(d: Date, tz: string) in src/util/dates.ts has a TODO comment that says it does not honor the user's time zone (tz). This function always calculates the start of the week (Monday) based on UTC time, not the user's local time zone. Therefore, for users in time zones ahead of UTC (e.g., Sydney), the calculated start of week is off by some hours, causing their summary email time check in isRollupDue() to be shifted and the Monday summary email to arrive on Tuesday.

The main file responsible is src/util/dates.ts where startOfWeek() is defined but ignores the tz parameter. This leads to the weekly rollup sending code in src/notifications/rollup.ts sending the email at the wrong local day/time for users in time zones ahead of UTC.
